1.title: AI Exploit Windows Have Dropped to Minutes | Jeetu Pate
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Cisco's Jeetu Patel discusses Shirudo, an open-source eBPF-based defense system built with OpenAI that autonomously blocks exploit paths in minutes while patches are tested; covers how autonomous agents change enterprise security posture and why trust infrastructure matters for scaling AI agents.

2.title: Generative Brain Models Will Arrive in 12 Months | UCSF
2.author: MTS
2.hook: UCSF neurosurgeon Eddie Chang discusses neural recordings showing the brain plans speech 250ms before vocalization, and frames the BCI industry shift from hardware-focused to generative world models of neural activity as the path to embodied interfaces by 2030.
